summary: Implementation is technically solid (80/80 validation checks pass), but CONFIG still holds stale/placeholder content that will embarrass FPT in front of the Subaru delegation: sessionDate is 'July 2025' (over a year in the past as of 2026-06-30) and all four demoUrl values are fake placeholders whose QR codes will encode broken links.

findings.title: sessionDate placeholder is over a year in the past
findings.suggestion: Replace `sessionDate: 'July 2025'` in CONFIG with the confirmed real event date (e.g. 'July 2026' or the exact date). This value appears in the hero meta chip and footer — visible on the welcome board the moment the delegation walks in.

findings.title: All four demoUrl values are placeholder URLs
findings.suggestion: Replace all four `demoUrl: 'https://demo.fpt-ccs.com/…'` placeholders in CONFIG.stations with the real, reachable demo URLs before the event. The QR codes encode these URLs verbatim — scanning them on the day will return 404 or DNS failure. Lines ~729 (Digital Key), ~745 (OTA), ~761 (AMS), ~775 (Nami).

findings.title: Google Fonts CDN may be blocked on corporate network
findings.suggestion: If FPT Tower's corporate network restricts fonts.googleapis.com, Inter will silently fall back to system-ui — acceptable but the polished brand look suffers. Consider self-hosting a WOFF2 subset of Inter or adding it base64-inline for a true offline-safe kiosk.

findings.title: Japanese greeting missing punctuation — needs native speaker sign-off
findings.suggestion: Spec explicitly flags 'confirm with native speaker'. Natural Japanese courtesy phrasing is `ようこそ、FPT へ` (with the ideographic comma 、after ようこそ) or the more compact `FPT へようこそ`. The current form is intelligible but may read as slightly unnatural to a Japanese professional audience.

findings.title: Cards 3 & 4 show only 2 features each — visually sparse vs Cards 1 (6) and 2 (4)
findings.suggestion: In the 2×2 grid, AMS (2 features) and Nami (2 features) will have noticeably more blank whitespace than Digital Key (6 features) and OTA (4 features). Consider expanding the feature lists in CONFIG.stations[2] and CONFIG.stations[3] with sub-steps or key differentiators to balance the visual weight.
